mapper.sql: chk02_daily_list_id AS daily_list_id, chk02_company_id AS company_id, chk02_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, chk01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, chk02_content AS content, chk02_explan AS explan, CAST(NULL AS varchar) AS reason, chk02_cutoff AS cutoff, chk02_window_no AS window_no, chk02_seq AS seq, chk02_use_yn AS use_yn, chk02_admin_daily_list_id AS admin_daily_list_id, (chk02_company_id = 0 OR COALESCE(chk02_admin_daily_list_id, 0) <> 0) AS admin_yn, chk02_write_group_id AS write_group_id, (SELECT sch22_write_group_nm FROM sch22_write_group WHERE sch22_write_group_id = chk02_write_group_id AND sch22_company_id = chk02_company_id) AS write_group_name

WITH RECURSIVE chk_tree_down(chk01_class_tree_id, chk01_parent_tree_id, depth, path, cycle) AS ( SELECT a.chk01_class_tree_id, a.chk01_parent_tree_id, 0, ARRAY[a.chk01_class_tree_nm::text], false FROM chk01_class_tree a WHERE 1=1 AND chk01_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) AND chk01_class_tree_id = #{parentTreeId} UNION ALL SELECT a.chk01_class_tree_id, a.chk01_parent_tree_id, b.depth + 1, array_append(b.path, a.chk01_class_tree_nm::text), a.chk01_class_tree_nm = any(b.path) FROM chk01_class_tree a, chk_tree_down b WHERE 1=1 AND a.chk01_parent_tree_id = b.chk01_class_tree_id AND a.chk01_company_id IN (0, #{companyId}) AND NOT cycle ) SELECT a.chk01_class_tree_id FROM chk_tree_down a
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chk02_daily_list INNER JOIN chk01_class_tree ON chk01_class_tree_id = chk02_class_tree_id WHERE chk02_daily_list_id = #{dailyListId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chk02_daily_list ( chk02_daily_list_id, chk02_company_id, chk02_class_tree_id, chk02_content, chk02_explan, chk02_cutoff, chk02_window_no, chk02_seq, chk02_use_yn, chk02_admin_daily_list_id ) VALUES ( #{dailyListId}, #{companyId}, #{req.classTreeId}, #{req.content}, #{req.explan}, #{req.cutoff}, #{req.windowNo}, #{req.seq}, #{req.useYn}, 0 )

SELECT FROM chk02_daily_list INNER JOIN chk01_class_tree ON chk01_class_tree_id = chk02_class_tree_id WHERE 1=1 AND chk02_class_tree_id IN (
) AND chk02_company_id = #{companyId} AND UPPER(CONCAT(chk01_class_tree_nm, chk02_content, chk02_explan)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText}) ORDER BY chk01_seq, chk02_seq

WITH chkList AS ( SELECT * FROM chk02_daily_list INNER JOIN chk01_class_tree ON chk01_class_tree_id = chk02_class_tree_id INNER JOIN sch22_write_group ON sch22_write_group_id = chk02_write_group_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT sch02_info_id, sch02_person_id AS person_id FROM sch02_share WHERE sch02_company_id = #{companyId} AND sch02_share_cd = '1' AND #{stdDate} BETWEEN sch02_start_date AND COALESCE(sch02_close_date,'9999-12-31') UNION SELECT sch02_info_id, emp03_person_id AS person_id FROM emp03_trans INNER JOIN sch02_share ON sch02_org_id = emp03_org_code_id WHERE (emp03_person_id, emp03_trans_date) IN ( SELECT emp03_person_id, max(emp03_trans_date) FROM emp03_trans INNER JOIN emp01_person ON emp01_person_id = emp03_person_id WHERE emp01_company_id = #{companyId} AND emp03_trans_date <= #{stdDate} GROUP BY emp03_person_id ) AND sch02_company_id = #{companyId} AND sch02_share_cd = '2' AND #{stdDate} BETWEEN sch02_start_date AND COALESCE(sch02_close_date,'9999-12-31') ) emp ON sch02_info_id = sch22_write_group_id WHERE 1=1 AND emp.person_id = #{personId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = emp.person_id AND ( ( emp04_start_date > #{stdDate} ) OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date,'9999-12-31') < #{stdDate} ) ) AND chk02_company_id = #{companyId} ) SELECT chk02_daily_list_id AS daily_list_id, chk02_class_tree_id AS class_tree_id, chk01_class_tree_nm AS class_tree_name, chk02_content AS content, chk02_explan AS explan, chk02_cutoff AS cutoff, chk02_window_no AS window_no, chk02_seq AS seq, chk02_use_yn AS use_yn, chk03_daily_list_write_id AS daily_list_write_id, chk03_answer_cd AS answer_code, chk03_reason AS reason, chk03_note AS note, COALESCE(chk03_confirm_yn,'false') = 'true' AS confirm_yn FROM chkList LEFT OUTER JOIN chk03_daily_list_write ON ( chk03_daily_list_id = chk02_daily_list_id AND chk03_company_id = #{companyId} AND chk03_person_id = person_id AND chk03_date = #{stdDate} ) WHERE chk02_class_tree_id IN (
) AND ( ( chk03_daily_list_write_id IS NULL AND COALESCE(chk01_use_yn,'false') = 'true' AND COALESCE(chk02_use_yn,'false') = 'true' ) OR ( chk03_daily_list_write_id IS NOT NULL ) )
AND chk03_answer_cd IS NULL
ORDER BY chk01_seq, chk01_class_tree_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" ASC, chk02_content COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" ASC
mapper.sql: SELECT *, chk01_class_tree_nm AS chk02_class_tree_nm, COALESCE(sch22_confirmer_id, f_get_confirmer_limit(person_id, #{date}, '0020')) AS confirmer_id FROM chk02_daily_list INNER JOIN chk01_class_tree ON chk01_class_tree_id = chk02_class_tree_id INNER JOIN sch22_write_group ON sch22_write_group_id = chk02_write_group_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT sch02_info_id, sch02_person_id person_id, emp00_kor_nm person_nm, emp00_org_code_id org_id, emp00_org_code_nm org_nm FROM sch02_share INNER JOIN getPerson(#{companyId}, #{date}) ON emp00_person_id = sch02_person_id WHERE sch02_company_id = #{companyId} AND sch02_share_cd = '1' AND #{date} BETWEEN sch02_start_date AND COALESCE(sch02_close_date,'9999-12-31') UNION ALL SELECT sch02_info_id, emp00_person_id person_id, emp00_kor_nm person_nm, emp00_org_code_id org_id, emp00_org_code_nm org_nm FROM sch02_share INNER JOIN getPerson(#{companyId}, #{date}) ON emp00_org_code_id = sch02_org_id WHERE sch02_company_id = #{companyId} AND sch02_share_cd = '2' AND #{date}::date BETWEEN sch02_start_date AND COALESCE(sch02_close_date,'9999-12-31') AND emp00_trans_cd != '900' /* 900:퇴직 */ ) emp ON sch02_info_id = sch22_write_group_id WHERE 1=1 AND chk02_company_id = #{companyId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp04_add_title WHERE emp04_add_person_id = person_id AND ( emp04_start_date > #{date} OR COALESCE(emp04_close_date,'9999-12-31') < #{date} ) )
LEFT OUTER JOIN chk03_daily_list_write ON ( chk03_daily_list_id = chk02_daily_list_id AND chk03_company_id = #{companyId} AND chk03_person_id = person_id AND chk03_date = #{date} )
